# Historical source audit controllers

The source manifest binds unchanged original code bytes. Keep the directory attributes and do not reformat archived files. This archive requires the original external captures, key logs, frozen plans and shared helper sources at the manifest paths; it is not a self-contained test suite. Run any adapted controller with a new hash and fresh output path.

No capture, key, complete case/plan/expected object, export, PDML, image, binary or log is included. Failed checkers and failed historical executions retain their separate conclusions; later corrections do not relabel them.

See [scope and results](../../../../../../../../docs/exec-plans/shark-public-corpus-20261025/ospfv3-boundaries-d677.md).
